title: Videographer in Burnley and Lancashire: Prices 2026
meta_description: What a videographer in Burnley or Lancashire costs in 2026: £390–£650 a half day, £690–£900 a full day, or monthly shoots from £149. What to check first.
keywords: how much does a videographer cost lancashire

faq.q: How much does a videographer cost in Burnley?
faq.a: Expect about £390 to £650 for a half day and £690 to £900 for a full day in 2026. Editing is sometimes charged separately, so check what each quote includes.

faq.q: How much does a videographer charge per hour in Lancashire?
faq.a: Most business videographers in Lancashire quote by the half day or full day rather than by the hour. Based on the UK ranges above, a half day of 3 to 4 hours works out at roughly £100 to £215 an hour.

faq.q: Is a videographer cheaper in Lancashire than in Manchester or London?
faq.a: London usually costs more: Whito puts London rates at or above the top of each UK range. Manchester prices vary by supplier, but booking a local Lancashire videographer also saves you travel and parking costs.

faq.q: How long does a short business video take to make?
faq.a: A simple promo or set of social clips can be filmed in a half day. Editing usually takes a few days to a week, depending on how many videos you need.

faq.q: Do I need a full day of filming?
faq.a: Rarely, for social media content. A half day, or a three-hour monthly shoot, is enough for testimonials, team clips and product shots. Full days suit events or several locations.

faq.q: Can ContentFellow film at my business in East Lancashire?
faq.a: Yes. Studio Fellow shoots happen on-site in Burnley and about 20 miles around it, including Padiham, Nelson, Colne, Accrington, Clitheroe and Blackburn. Editing, social media, websites and SEO are delivered remotely across the UK.
It depends on the contract. Make sure you can use the footage on your website, social media and paid ads without extra fees, and ask whether raw clips are included.
